Author: syberdamon
Name: Combat Recorder
Description: Writes one compressed JSON-lines file per duty: every action you, your party and enemies use (with damage/heal numbers), buffs and debuffs gained and lost, HP/MP and positions twice a second, casts, deaths and target changes. Party members are recorded by job and slot, never by name. /crec mark <note> drops a marker you can point to later ("downtime here"). Nothing leaves your PC.
Punchline: Records your fights (actions, damage, heals, buffs, HP, movement) to compact local files for review.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Cooldown Grid
Description: Pick any of your job's cooldown abilities and sort them into groups. Each group gets its own window: a grid of ability icons showing time remaining and charges. Click an icon to use the ability, just like a hotbar button. Settings are saved per job; All four tanks ship with a starter layout.
Punchline: Clickable cooldown grids, grouped into Defensive (self), Defensive (group), Support, and your own groups.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Map Click Nav
Description: Hold a modifier (Ctrl by default) and left-click a spot on any zone's map. Map Click Nav places your flag there, teleports to the nearest attuned aetheryte if that's faster (always, for another zone), mounts with Mount Roulette, and has vnavmesh fly you there if flight is unlocked (or ride there if not). A Stop button appears while traveling. Requires vnavmesh.
Punchline: Ctrl+click any map to teleport, mount, and fly there with vnavmesh.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Mit Planner
Description: Detects your duty, runs the fight's timeline (cactbot format, synced to the boss's actual abilities), and shows the next mechanics with countdowns and type (tank buster, raid-wide, ...). Attach your cooldowns to specific mechanics per job, and get a callout a few seconds before each one. Optional per-cooldown auto-use. Ships with every fight cactbot has a timeline for (300+ dungeons, trials, raids and ultimates, refreshed weekly), with tank busters and raid-wides pre-tagged.
Punchline: Boss timeline with countdowns, plus a per-job cooldown plan that tells you what to press and when.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Poetics Spender
Description: Pick a topsoil (Thanalan or Shroud). One click teleports you to Idyllshire, buys Unidentifiable Ore/Shell from Hismena with all your Poetics (150 each), and trades it to Bertana for Grade 3 topsoil. A movable alert pops up when your Poetics reach a threshold (1800 by default); click it to run. Requires vnavmesh. English client.
Punchline: Turn your Poetics into Grade 3 topsoil with one click, plus a near-cap alert.

Author: syberdamon
Name: Tank Stance Manager
Description: MT mode keeps tank stance on at all times. OT mode toggles tank stance to hold your enmity inside a configurable band of the main tank's enmity (default 75%-90%), and turns it on if you are pushed to #3. Supports PLD, WAR, DRK, GNB.
Punchline: Keeps tank stance on as MT, or holds an enmity band as OT.
